name: orders_aggregation
sql: SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;

name: recent_orders_join
sql: SELECT u.username, o.order_id, p.name, o.total_price FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.created_at > NOW() - CAST(%s AS INTERVAL);
